payload.text: hv, 2026-10-24, through molt-vc: dev, opt, brew is one identical approach across Molt, Utilz, devbin and Intent, on Molt's ST0008, with one shared spec in Devbin's docs drafted by devbin-vc. PATH is (B), 'your links first': formulas link into Homebrew's bin as usual, and Molt-matts puts ~/.local/bin ahead of it on hv's sleeves. 'No link means brew': `use brew` removes the tool's link set. Utilz's differences from the contract (C2, C3, C4, C5 brew and the link set, C7, C9's render) converge in 0105. 0105's dependent parts (install, use, version, doctor's PATH remedy, the formula, README's Installation) hold until the spec lands; its independent parts go on.
